content.title: Artemis was the Greek goddess of the hunt, wild nature, wilderness, animals, the moon, and chastity. Daughter of Zeus and Leto, and the twin sister of Apollo, she was a protector of young girls and women, especially those in childbirth. She was often depicted with a bow and arrow, accompanied by a deer, and is the Roman equivalent of the goddess Diana. | The Tattoo Room | Facebook
